messages:
claire: Starting a short thread to lock owners for the 'staggered onramp' plan. Product wants pilot -> staggered public onramp, but infra/runtime/security sequence may force reorder. Who owns gating and rollback?

ravi: I'm in. Need answered: target concurrency per-tenant, expected burst factor, and whether per-tenant quotas are required from day1.

claire: Target: pilot tenants ~50 concurrent each, platform-wide burst up to 8k rps. Product asks per-tenant soft quotas at pilot, hard quotas for GA.

jamal: Runtime: for pilot we can use shared routing + conservative batching. For GA we need per-tenant queueing + fair-share scheduling. Work: add per-tenant token-bucket and priority lanes. Owner: runtime (jamal). Risk: queue head-of-line blocking if one tenant spikes.

sofia: Security: GA requires tenant key separation and audit trails. Pilot can use scoped service keys but must be opt-in and limited. Also need a retention policy for pilot logs (30d). Owner: security (sofia).

kevin: Infra: will need a staged capacity plan. Proposal: pilot capacity reservation (6 GPUs) + autoscale policy tuned to burst windows. For GA, provision 20% headroom and per-tenant routing tables. I'll draft infra runbook and cost floor.

claire: Product proposes three phases: 1) Pilot (opt-in, soft quotas, scoped keys) = 4w; 2) Staggered onramp (controlled signup, per-tenant quotas, quota enforcement) = +3w; 3) GA (open signup, HSM-backed keys, strict SLOs) = +4w after security signoff.

jamal: Runtime tasks for Phase 2: implement token-bucket per-tenant, add fairness scheduler, health-hooks for queue-length. Example config snippet for token-bucket:
```
queues:
  tenant_bucket:
    rate: 200rps
    burst: 400
    window_ms: 1000
```

ravi: Infra tasks: reserve GPUs for pilot, add monitoring dashboards for per-tenant p95 and error-rate, and create quota enforcer service. I'll open INF ticket.

sofia: Gating checklist draft for GA: HSM & KMS tested, audit logs validated, per-tenant key rotation, privacy review complete, rollback plan approved. For staggered onramp we require opt-in agreement and data retention consent.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created INF-9202 'staggered-onramp infra reservations' and linked this thread.

claire: Action owners: claire -> ship pilot invite list + consent text; jamal -> runtime queueing + canary plan; ravi -> infra ticket + dashboards; sofia -> GA gating checklist + retention policy. Can we all react if you accept owners?

jamal: Accept :white_check_mark:

sofia: Accept for pilot; GA gated until audit :white_check_mark:

ravi: Accept. Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to firm dates.

claire: Thanks all. I'll post the pilot PRD after this thread and attach customer opt-in wording.
